name: School of the Arts (SOTA)
summary: Specialised arts secondary school combining creative practice with academic pathways.
body: SOTA is Singapore’s leading pre-tertiary arts school. Entry is talent-based and highly selective. Expat families with artistically driven teens should understand audition timelines years ahead — this is not a casual transfer option. Ask how performance / showcase fundraisers and book-fair style events communicate volunteer shifts to dual-career parents, and how haze or unhealthy PSI days alter outdoor call times. Arts campuses still run exclusion and night-illness weeks hard — keep written return clocks for respiratory bugs beside showcase calendars.
waitlistNotes: Audition-driven — follow SOTA admissions calendar strictly.
